concept: CloudTrail: API call audit — who, when, from which IP
tests: Distinguishing monitoring services: who made a specific API call and from where.
expected: AWS CloudTrail — logs the identity, time, and source IP of the call (DeleteSecurityGroup). Triggers: "which IAM user", "deleted", "source IP" — a "who did what" question.
why_not: CloudWatch is performance metrics; Config is configuration state and history, but not the identity of each call; X-Ray is request tracing.
